items.stem:
Read the survey report and answer the questions that follow.

A survey on water use was carried out in Varanasi in 2025. 300 families were asked which activity uses most of their daily water. The results were: bathing – 11%; washing clothes – 16%; cooking and drinking – 26%; cleaning the house – 5%; gardening – 42%. The organisers said the findings would help them plan better, and they encouraged people to think about how they conserve and use their time and resources.

(i) Which response was the most common?  (a) cooking and drinking  (b) bathing  (c) gardening  (d) washing clothes
(ii) How many families chose "bathing"?  (a) 330  (b) 11  (c) 33  (d) 78
(iii) Did more than half of the families choose "gardening"? Give the figure.
(iv) In the passage, the word "conserve" means …  (a) protect from waste or loss  (b) easy to reach, enter or use  (c) communication by letters or messages  (d) calming
(v) What fraction of the families did NOT choose "bathing"? Answer as a percentage.  (a) 89%  (b) 74%  (c) 11%  (d) 39%
items.answer: (i) (c) gardening (ii) (c) 33 (iii) No – 42%, which is less than half. (iv) (a) protect from waste or loss (v) (a) 89%
items.markingKey: (i) (c) gardening (ii) (c) 33 (iii) No – 42%, which is less than half. (iv) (a) protect from waste or loss (v) (a) 89% (1 mark each.)
